name: trustedrisk-alert-agent
description: Federated A2A partner that subscribes to TrustedRisk's drift_monitor and emits webhook alerts when calibration tiers escalate to warn/alert. Demonstrates the multi-agent COMPOSE-1 pattern: an upstream decision agent (TrustedRisk) feeds a specialist monitoring agent that owns alert routing + suppression policy.

skills.name: Register a webhook to receive drift alerts
skills.description: POST a webhook_url + optional severity threshold. The alert agent will deliver alert_event payloads (drift KPI, severity, generated_at, source_agent) to the subscriber whenever check_drift_now or a periodic poll detects warn/alert tiers.
examples: Subscribe my Slack relay endpoint, severity threshold = warn

skills.name: Synchronously poll TrustedRisk for current drift state
skills.description: Hits TrustedRisk's /api/calibration/status, classifies the overall tier, and (when warn/alert) emits an alert event to all matching subscribers. Returns the alert payload it dispatched (or null when tier=ok).
examples: Run a one-shot drift check on the past 24h DecisionCards
Poll TrustedRisk for calibration tier and dispatch alerts now

skills.name: List recent dispatched alerts
skills.description: Returns the last N alert events the agent dispatched, with subscriber delivery status and dispatch timestamp. Useful for the playground orchestration tab and operator dashboards.
examples: Show me the last 10 alerts dispatched
What alerts went out in the last hour?

alerting.description: In-process subscription registry + best-effort webhook delivery via httpx. Subscriptions are NOT persisted across restarts (this is a demo agent — production would back the registry with durable storage). Phase 3.4 — wired into the A2A push-notification model: clients call `CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig` with a webhook URL + optional severity threshold; the registry dispatches `TaskStatusUpdateEvent` payloads when drift fires.
